topics.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol with a 20% lower Astra API price
topics.summary: On November 17, 2026, OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra, for demanding professional work, and GPT-6.2 Sol, for fast everyday tasks, in ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API. Astra's API price falls 20%, Sol keeps its price, and OpenAI rates both at its Critical cybersecurity threshold.

topics.title: Isomorphic Labs raises $5 billion in a Series C months after a $2.1 billion round
topics.summary: On November 17, 2026, Alphabet's Isomorphic Labs announced a $5 billion Series C co-led by Greenoaks and Sequoia Capital, with Andreessen Horowitz and continued backing from Alphabet. The money will scale its IsoDDE drug design engine and move first programs toward clinical trials; valuation is not disclosed.

topics.title: OpenAI names four outside groups for embedded safety assessments, narrower than Altman's pledge
topics.summary: On November 16, 2026, OpenAI said Apollo Research, METR, Transluce and Goodfire will run the first phase of embedded assessments with deep access to models and systems. Researchers told NPR the access is narrower than Sam Altman's September pledge of employee-like access.
